paper.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition

result.summary: 本文针对深度神经网络随深度增加出现的退化问题（训练误差反而升高），提出了残差学习框架，让堆叠层学习相对于输入的残差映射而非原始映射 [S1.p3][S1.p5]。作者通过恒等快捷连接实现该框架，且不增加额外参数或计算复杂度 [S1.p6]。在 ImageNet 上，34 层残差网络比 18 层更优，且比对应的普通网络降低 top-1 误差 3.5% [S4.SS1.p6][S4.SS1.p7]；152 层残差网络单模型 top-5 验证误差为 4.49%，六模型集成在测试集上达到 3.57% 误差，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。作者还在 CIFAR-10 上成功训练了超过 100 层乃至 1202 层的网络 [S1.p8][S4.SS2.p8]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：当更深的网络能够开始收敛时，会出现退化问题——随着深度增加，准确率饱和并迅速下降，且这种退化并非由过拟合引起，向适当深的模型添加更多层会导致更高的训练误差 [S1.p3]。作者指出，按构造存在一个解使更深模型的训练误差不应高于其较浅对应模型，但现有求解器无法找到可比或更好的解 [S1.p4]。

evidence.quote: When deeper networks are able to start converging, a degradation problem has been exposed: with the network depth increasing, accuracy gets saturated (which might be unsurprising) and then degrades rapidly.
Unexpectedly, such degradation is not caused by overfitting, and adding more layers to a suitably deep model leads to higher training error
The existence of this constructed solution indicates that a deeper model should produce no higher training error than its shallower counterpart.
But experiments show that our current solvers on hand are unable to find solutions that are comparably good or better than the constructed solution

method.text: 论文提出深度残差学习框架：不期望每几个堆叠层直接拟合目标底层映射 H(x)，而是显式地让这些层拟合残差映射 F(x):=H(x)-x，原始映射被重铸为 F(x)+x [S1.p5]。该形式通过前馈神经网络的“快捷连接”实现，快捷连接执行恒等映射，其输出加到堆叠层的输出上，且不增加额外参数或计算复杂度 [S1.p6]。当输入输出维度不一致时，可用线性投影 W_s 匹配维度，但实验表明恒等映射足以解决退化问题且更经济，因此 W_s 仅在匹配维度时使用 [S3.SS2.p3]。

evidence.quote: Instead of hoping each few stacked layers directly fit a desired underlying mapping, we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping.
The original mapping is recast into $\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x})+\mathbf{x}$.
The formulation of $\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x})+\mathbf{x}$ can be realized by feedforward neural networks with “shortcut connections” (Fig. 2).
Identity shortcut connections add neither extra parameter nor computational complexity.
But we will show by experiments that the identity mapping is sufficient for addressing the degradation problem and is economical, and thus $W_{s}$ is only used when matching dimensions.

experiments.text: 论文在 ImageNet 2012 分类数据集（1000 类，128 万训练图像，5 万验证图像，10 万测试图像）上评估方法，报告 top-1 和 top-5 错误率 [S4.SS1.p1]。训练设置包括：随机采样短边在 [256,480] 的图像、224×224 裁剪、逐像素均值减法、标准颜色增强、每个卷积后激活前使用批归一化、SGD 小批量 256、学习率从 0.1 开始并在误差平台时除以 10、训练最多 60×10^4 次迭代、权重衰减 0.0001、动量 0.9、不使用 dropout [S3.SS4.p1]。此外在 CIFAR-10（5 万训练图像、1 万测试图像、10 类）上进行研究，使用简单架构，网络输入 32×32 图像，堆叠 6n 层 3×3 卷积，特征图大小分别为 {32,16,8}，滤波器数分别为 {16,32,64}，所有情况使用恒等快捷连接 [S4.SS2.p1][S4.SS2.p2]。

evidence.quote: We evaluate our method on the ImageNet 2012 classification dataset that consists of 1000 classes.
The models are trained on the 1.28 million training images, and evaluated on the 50k validation images.
We adopt batch normalization (BN) right after each convolution and before activation, following.
We use SGD with a mini-batch size of 256.
The learning rate starts from 0.1 and is divided by 10 when the error plateaus, and the models are trained for up to $60\times 10^{4}$ iterations.
We use a weight decay of 0.0001 and a momentum of 0.9. We do not use dropout, following the practice in.
We conducted more studies on the CIFAR-10 dataset, which consists of 50k training images and 10k testing images in 10 classes.
The network inputs are 32 $\times$ 32 images, with the per-pixel mean subtracted.
Then we use a stack of $6n$ layers with 3 $\times$ 3 convolutions on the feature maps of sizes $\{32,16,8\}$ respectively, with 2 $n$ layers for each feature map size.
On this dataset we use identity shortcuts in all cases ( i.e., option A), so our residual models have exactly the same depth, width, and number of parameters as the plain counterparts.

findings.text: 在 ImageNet 上，34 层普通网络比 18 层普通网络验证误差更高，且在整个训练过程中训练误差都更高，呈现退化问题 [S4.SS1.p3]。使用残差学习后情况反转：34 层 ResNet 比 18 层 ResNet 好 2.8%，且训练误差显著更低并能泛化到验证数据 [S4.SS1.p6]。与对应的普通网络相比，34 层 ResNet 将 top-1 误差降低 3.5% [S4.SS1.p7]。152 层 ResNet 单模型 top-5 验证误差为 4.49%，优于所有先前集成结果；六模型集成在测试集上达到 3.57% top-5 误差，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。在 CIFAR-10 上，普通网络随深度增加训练误差升高，而 ResNet 克服了优化困难并随深度增加获得准确率提升 [S4.SS2.p4][S4.SS2.p5]。1202 层网络训练误差低于 0.1%，测试误差为 7.93% [S4.SS2.p8]。

evidence.quote: The results in Table 2 show that the deeper 34-layer plain net has higher validation error than the shallower 18-layer plain net.
the 34-layer plain net has higher training error throughout the whole training procedure
First, the situation is reversed with residual learning – the 34-layer ResNet is better than the 18-layer ResNet (by 2.8%).
More importantly, the 34-layer ResNet exhibits considerably lower training error and is generalizable to the validation data.
Second, compared to its plain counterpart, the 34-layer ResNet reduces the top-1 error by 3.5% (Table 2), resulting from the successfully reduced training error (Fig. 4 right vs. left).
Our 152-layer ResNet has a single-model top-5 validation error of 4.49%.
This leads to 3.57% top-5 error on the test set (Table 5). This entry won the 1st place in ILSVRC 2015.
The deep plain nets suffer from increased depth, and exhibit higher training error when going deeper.
our ResNets manage to overcome the optimization difficulty and demonstrate accuracy gains when the depth increases.
this $10^{3}$ -layer network is able to achieve training error $<$ 0.1% (Fig. 6, right). Its test error is still fairly good (7.93%, Table 6).

limitations.text: 作者指出，1202 层网络的测试结果比 110 层网络更差，尽管两者训练误差相近，作者认为这是因为过拟合，该网络对此小数据集可能不必要地大 [S4.SS2.p9]。作者表示本文未使用 maxout/dropout，仅通过深而窄的架构施加正则化，结合更强正则化可能改善结果，留待未来研究 [S4.SS2.p9]。此外，作者提到深度普通网络可能存在指数级低的收敛速率，影响训练误差的降低，这种优化困难的原因将在未来研究 [S4.SS1.p4]。

evidence.quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error.
We argue that this is because of overfitting. The 1202-layer network may be unnecessarily large (19.4M) for this small dataset.
In this paper, we use no maxout/dropout and just simply impose regularization via deep and thin architectures by design
But combining with stronger regularization may improve results, which we will study in the future.
We conjecture that the deep plain nets may have exponentially low convergence rates, which impact the reducing of the training error
The reason for such optimization difficulties will be studied in the future.
